C1.worst_defect: The hero says what it is ("open-source point of sale for Vendure", badge "Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0") but never says who it is not for or how it compares with Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed. A merchant weighing a hosted till gets no 'choose this if / choose something else if' line. The footer gives no maker beyond "MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI."

C2.worst_defect: There are signs of a thinly maintained project. The changelog's last plugin release is 0.3.0 on 2026-10-06 ("Released the same day as 0.2.0, a few hours later"), with nothing in the six weeks since. A known bug is documented but not fixed: "Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder". No maintainer, company or support channel is named anywhere. The demo sends "anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com", a domain the home page never explains.
C2.where: changelog.desktop.01; home.desktop.02 (demo vs store table); footer

C3.worst_defect: The path works, but a fresh 0.3.0 install still needs a hand-fix: the device-key role lacks ReadOrder, so "the till's order history is refused until you add it to the role". Quick start step 6 also changes tax settings that are "store-wide and also affect the web shop", a side effect on the live shop that a cautious adopter must accept to get a till running.

C4.worst_defect: The Overview's "Next steps" cards leave out Connect a till, Troubleshooting and Changelog, which are only in the sidebar. Scanner support also contradicts itself: the home "Barcode scanners" card names keyboard-wedge scanners only, while At the till adds "or the device's camera" in the same list that says "Tablets and phones are not tested yet."
C4.where: docs.desktop.01 (Next steps); at-the-till.phone.01 vs home.desktop.02 (Barcode scanners card)

C5.worst_defect: After the first two feature cards, the home feature section becomes a dense two-column text list with no visuals. A buyer comparing it with Square's or Shopify POS's feature pages scans a wall of prose instead of seeing the till do things.
C5.where: home.desktop.02 (features below the first two cards)

C6.worst_defect: The hero app screenshot is scaled so small on the phone that its category chips are cut off mid-word ("Gif"). The phone header shows only Docs and Live demo, so Quick start is hidden behind the chevron.

C7.worst_defect: Docs titles are generic, e.g. "Overview | VendurePOS", so a search result or tab gives no hint it is the POS docs overview. Otherwise solid: Lighthouse mobile 98/100/100/100, CLS 0, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap (10 URLs), JSON-LD and /api/search all 200, and the 404 page returns a real 404.

overall_worst.defect: The site never says who builds or supports VendurePOS (the footer only says "MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI."). The plugin has not shipped since 0.3.0 on 2026-10-06, and a known ReadOrder role bug is documented ("Not in the release notes…") instead of fixed. A sceptic advising a client on a till that handles money cannot judge support or longevity, so they would steer the client to Shopify POS or Square.
overall_worst.fix: Add a short 'Who builds this' line on home and the docs Overview: maintainer or company, release cadence, issue tracker and support channel. Then ship a plugin patch that adds ReadOrder to the device-key role, or state when it lands.
